title: Repression of bacterial gene expression by antivitamin B12 binding to a cobalamin riboswitch
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00308C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Florian J. Widner, Naziyat I. Khan, Evelyne Deery, Martin J. Warren, Michiko E. Taga, Bernhard Kräutler
Coenzyme B12 and its Rh-analogue, the antivitamin B12 AdoRhbl, bind both the btuB-riboswitch with exceptional affinity and inhibit expression of the bacterial B12 uptake protein BtuB, signifying AdoRhbl's high potential as multifunctional antibiotic.
